memory_candidates.content: In BimodalLogic, a build-time axiom pin on FormalSystem/MainResults.lean is a FOUR-edit-site change across three files: the page itself, BOTH coupled heredocs in scripts/check-module-invariants.sh (C14_BASELINE and the generated C14LEAN Lean file, compared by exact string equality and required to list the same declarations in the same order), and the per-file count in scripts/debug-artifact-allowlist.txt (C27). Read the C27 value off the gate's own reported 'tree' number, never compute it by arithmetic: the gate reported 'allow-list 54, tree 66' where naive arithmetic (54 + 12 directives) happened to agree but the gate's masker is the authority. Verify heredoc parity mechanically by diffing the two extracted name lists, not by counting. Confirmed working end to end.

In BimodalLogic, FrameClass minimality (fc < .ZTime) and FrameClass characterization (ValidIn fc phi <-> fc = .ZTime) are genuinely different claims, because the frame-class order is NOT linear: .Dense and .RTime are incomparable with .ZTime rather than below it. eq_base_of_lt_ztime reaches only .Base, so a characterization needs separate refutations at .Dense and .RTime plus a four-way `cases fc`, never a route through the order fact. Also: `by decide` FAILS on FrameClass `<` (only `<=` has a DecidableRel instance). Discharging Sat: .Dense is an anonymous-constructor instance pair; .RTime adds a third component, TaskFrame.IsComplete, from Real.exists_isLUB.
